method.input: Synthetic net/long/short quantities and marks; every market is admitted once, with fixed margin arithmetic per contribution.
method.parity: Before timing, per-target exclusion scans and one-pass aggregate-minus-target results are compared for every market count.
method.baseline: For every target admission, iterate all other markets and recompute the quantity-based margin contribution.
method.candidate: Compute each market contribution once for the visible timestamp into a Vec indexed by runtime market index, build the portfolio total, then read total minus the target contribution for each admission.
method.timing_scope: Synthetic position aggregation and integer margin arithmetic only; excludes BTreeMap/ledger access costs, actual margin engine, order admission, matching, I/O, and full backtest orchestration.

limitations: The snapshot algorithm is slower for two markets in this synthetic microbenchmark. Production therefore only builds the snapshot with at least four configured specs; smaller portfolios retain the original per-target calculation.

The candidate and production both use indexed Vec contribution storage, but the benchmark uses fixed synthetic arithmetic instead of production Ledger lookups, margin rules, and order admission; timings remain directional and not directly transferable.
The benchmark is not end-to-end A-share or portfolio backtest evidence, and the nine product profile measurement statuses are unchanged.
